query:
SELECT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM image_platforms p
               WHERE p.image_id = ?1
                 AND (p.state IN ('queued', 'pulling')
                      OR EXISTS (
                          SELECT 1 FROM sync_jobs j
                          WHERE j.status IN ('queued', 'running')
                            AND json_extract(j.payload, '$.kind') = 'pull'
                            AND json_extract(j.payload, '$.platform_id') = p.id))
           ) AS "pending!: i64"
